title: RewardHackDetector: A Behavioral Probe Battery for Inference-Time Reward Hacking

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: models gaming evaluation rubrics undermines trust in benchmarks. A standardized probe battery enables auditing evaluation setups before deployment, directly addressing documented reward hacking in frontier models.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing 100 scenarios where reward hacking is possible requires understanding what reward hacking looks like in practice. Black-box API access makes execution easier, but scenario design needs domain expertise beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 100 task scenarios across multiple hacking categories is substantial. Measuring exploit rates and producing per-category scores is well-defined, but creating quality scenarios that actually test for hacking is labor-intensive.
